description:
Filmland Spirits - Stories you can Drink
Whiskey geeks and movie nerds. That’s us. Welcome to Filmland Spirits, where we invite you to immerse yourself in our award-winning, great-tasting spirits and our original characters and stories.

Whiskey Lineup - Lights! Spirits! Action!
Each of our award-winning whiskies are 'produced on location’ in Kentucky, USA and like our original movie concepts, they are sometimes outlandish and over-the top, but always classic and entertaining.

Moonlight Mayhem! Small Batch Bourbon Whiskey
Delicious and sweet with cherry and citrus on the nose, vanilla and caramel on the tongue and an intricate finish of toffee and toasted oak. Enjoyed neat, on the rocks, or in a cocktail, this smooth blend will delight werewolves and humans alike.

Moonlight Mayhem! Extended Cut Cash Strength Bourbon Whiskey 
Cherries and chocolate on the nose and tongue with a spectacularly creamy mouthfeel and an endless finish of cacao, leather, and applewood. Enjoyed neat, or with a drop of water, this special blend will transform werewolves and humans alike.

Ryes of the Robots Smatt Batch Straight Rye
Complex and spicy with cinnamon and cloves on the nose, mint and pepper on the tongue and a long, chocolatey finish with hints of oak. Enjoyed neat, on the rocks, or in a cocktail, this smooth blend will amaze robots and humans alike.

Unique Selling Point - A Blockbuster in Every Bottle
Crafted with a movie-making mindset. For us, producing great whiskey is like making an unforgettable movie. Start with a killer script. Gather all the best ingredients and craftspeople and blend them together in just the right way to create something truly unique.

We craft our story based on an original B-movie concept, with heroes, villains and a plot that keeps your mouth watering.

Our spirits are masterfully distilled, blended to perfection then bottled “on location” in the USA.

We wrap each story around a bottle featuring an original B-movie poster label in pulp-style art, to create an instant classic.

Payment Terms
1 - 2 Bottles: $0 - $175 = 7.5%
3+ Bottles: $175 + = 10%
